description: This file defines data model classes and types for the torchgen typing system, including base C++ types, various CType subclasses, NamedCType, Binding, and Expr classes. It serves as a foundational module for type representations in code generation, distinguishing between implementation-agnostic base types and ATen/c10 specific types.

classes.name: BaseCppType
classes.description: Represents a fully qualified or unqualified C++ type name, used as a base for specific type instances.

classes.name: CType
classes.description: Abstract base class for C++ type representations, with subclasses for specific type categories.

classes.name: BaseCType
classes.description: Represents a basic, non-templated C++ type.

classes.name: ConstRefCType
classes.description: Represents a const reference to another CType.

classes.name: VectorCType
classes.description: Represents a std::vector of another CType.

classes.name: ArrayCType
classes.description: Represents a std::array of a CType with a fixed size.

classes.name: TupleCType
classes.description: Represents a std::tuple of multiple CTypes.

classes.name: MutRefCType
classes.description: Represents a mutable reference to a CType.

classes.name: NamedCType
classes.description: Associates a CType with a semantic name, indicating its role or meaning.

classes.name: Binding
classes.description: Represents a C++ binding site for a formal parameter, including name, type, argument info, and default value.

classes.name: Expr
classes.description: Represents a C++ expression with its syntax and associated NamedCType.
